name: makehuman
note: MakeHuman 'Default' skeleton, as exported by the MakeHuman C++ FBX writer. Bone names are bare (no prefix); sides are a '.L'/'.R' suffix, fingers are 'finger<N>-<seg>' (finger1=thumb..finger5=pinky), and the hand bone is named 'wrist'. normalised_bone_name lowercases and strips the dot and hyphen, so the raw names here match. The fingers are listed so the table identifies the rig unambiguously and the hands deform from their own weights, but retarget_digits is false: MakeHuman's finger bones are oriented differently from the clip library's, so retargeting a body clip's fixed finger grip would curl them on the wrong axis and shatter the hand. With it off the fingers keep their natural rest pose while the body animates — which is what body clips want, and what Mixamo does.
